vulnerability.name: USN-8168-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that tar-rs embedded in rustc incorrectly handled symlinks when unpacking a tar archive. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a specially crafted tar archive, a remote attacker could use this issue to modify permissions of arbitrary directories outside the extraction root, and possibly escalate privileges.

statements.status_notes: rustc could be made to modify permissions on arbitrary directories.
